HOW THIS MAKES IT ETHICALLY SOURCED
  • No informal mining. A licensed, large-scale underground mine means no artisanal or informal workings enter the supply, so working conditions can be inspected.
  • Low-risk location. The mine lies outside conflict-affected and high-risk areas as defined by the OECD guidance on due diligence for mineral supply chains.
  • Audited every year. An independent assessor checks worker safety, fair pay and the absence of child or forced labour.
  • Environmental controls. Tailings are held in a lined storage facility and about 90% of process water is recycled.
  • Recycled share. The 42% recycled gold adds no new mining impact.
  • Provable chain. Batch code GB-2026-0417 follows the gold from the mine gate to this pendant, so each claim can be checked below.
Doré bars from the Linjiang Ridge mine and recycled scrap are refined to 999 fineness at an accredited refinery, Southern Delta Gold Refining Co. (illustrative name). An independent assay confirms 999.2 parts per thousand, and the report is filed under the certificate number shown below.

ROLE ON THIS PIECE

Designed the pendant (mould R29041), carved the wax model and hand-chased the relief over about 38 hours at the Master Studio atelier. The inlays were set under her supervision.

Each piece is tested by X-ray fluorescence, weighed and measured against its mould (R29041), then checked under magnification for finish and setting. A serial number links the piece to barcode R18436 and its certificate.
The pendant is packed in a presentation box with its certificate of authenticity, sealed with a tamper-evident label and delivered insured to your Singapore address. Delivery is free, and a signature is required on receipt.

THE STORY OF CTF • HUÁ
“A small gourd, carrying a long blessing.”

In Chinese tradition the gourd, hulu, is a charm for protection and good fortune. Its name echoes fulu, blessing and prosperity, and its many seeds stand for a family that grows.

Here the gourd is cast in 999 gold and framed by a relief of clouds and scrolls. A green coin-shaped inlay at the neck and a red roundel at the belly give it colour. Above it, a gold bead carries the character 福, fu, the wish for blessing.

Worn close to the heart, the pendant is meant to be handed on: a blessing for the wearer first, and for whoever receives it next.

A HERITAGE OF FIRSTS

  1. 1929Chow Tai Fook is founded in Guangzhou.
  2. 1972First to launch 999.9 gold jewellery in Hong Kong and Macao.
  3. 1990Introduces its “Fixed Price” policy: the price on the tag is the final price.
  4. 2014Master Studio begins working with the Chinese University of Hong Kong to study historic goldworking techniques.
  5. 2016Launches T•MARK, bringing traceability to its diamonds.
  6. TodayCTF • HUÁ carries that craft into pieces like this pendant.
